newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stock prices mixed, Unibanka up.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stock prices mixed, Unibanka up.

text.p: Latvian stock volumes slipped slightly on Thursday but leading share Unibanka regained some of its lost ground, dealers said.
Turnover slipped to 173,000 lats from 188,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's index Rietumu edged up 0.26 percent to 228.17.

Unibanka, which last week saw a continued slide following the cancellation of its merger with Zemes bank in a surprise move, climbed slightly higher to advance five santimes to 4.80 lats on volume of 34,000 lats.
Unibanka dividends and bonus shares will be received by their owers on April 7.
"Unibanka can be expected to fluctuate between 4.70 and 4.90 lats until April 7 and then go down proportionally," Leonid Ruderman, dealer with Parex Bank, said.
"April could be stable in general, apart from fluctuations which might be caused by news from shareholders meetings," Ruderman said.
The market is now expecting the shareholder meetings of Daugavpils Chain, Kaija, Rigas Raugs, Vitransauto, Salacgriva 95 and Strenci Forestry.
On the official list, Riga Transport Fleet had the day's biggest turnover of 44,600 lats and was stable at 1.77 lats.
Staburadze confectionery fell 16 santimes to 2.70 lats and traded 3,000 lats.
Daugavpils Chain factory led the secondary list with 31,600 lats of shares traded as it advanced to 2.80 lats from 2.73 lats, regaining ground it lost earlier this week.
Kaija added two santimes to 2.40 lats and turned over 10,900 lats worth of shares and Rigas Raugs jumped to 3.90 lats from 3.45 lats or 13 percent. It traded 9,800 lats of shares.

Strenci forestry and Roja fish cannery were also well traded. Strenci saw volume of 9,300 lats and advanced 10 santimes to 1.85 lats. Roja remained stable at 2.84 as 4,500 lats of its shares changed hands.
Lode Brick maker saw a correction today as it fell 10 santimes to 2.50 lats. It traded 5,000 lats.
